description: Landslides Pomeroy Study is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by Allegheny County. This dataset is harvested on a weekly basis from Allegheny County's GIS data portal. For more information about landslides in Allegheny County, visit the Allegheny County Landslide Portal. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher Allegheny County. Its tags are _etl, landslide. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-08-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
